subject: GCP Marketplace purchase path config & entitlement mapping for AcmeCloud
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@google.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: GCP purchase path + entitlement mapping for our upcoming listing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's listing requirements earlier. We're ready to lock in the buyflow and entitlement mapping before the go-live next month. Two areas we need help with:

1) How to map our SKU/entitlement matrix (subscription vs metered add-ons) to the GCP buyflow.
2) What Redwood needs from Procurement to enable purchase-to-invoice transitions (billing account mapping, reseller vs direct sale flags).

Attached: purchase_path_diagram_v2.png (sketch of Acme SKUs) and a draft of our procurement terms.

High-level ask: Can your team confirm the recommended mapping and a simple checklist we can share with our procurement team and GCP?

Goal: finalize mapping and get DocuSign order by 27 May.

Thanks,
Jason
Jason Lee
Head of Cloud Partnerships, AcmeCloud
procurement@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP purchase path + entitlement mapping for our upcoming listing

Jason —

Appreciate the diagram. We can definitely get you a concrete mapping and the procurement checklist. High level next steps from our side:

- Karthik will draft the SKU <-> GCP entitlement mapping (subscription vs metered).
- Vivek will confirm billing account/reseller flags and any downstream invoice handoffs.
- I will produce a compact checklist (Procurement -> Legal -> Marketplace Ops) and propose the DocuSign flow.

Can we target internal alignment by EOD Wednesday so I can send the external-facing checklist by Thursday? That should give you time to circulate to Acme procurement.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP purchase path + entitlement mapping for our upcoming listing

Quick notes after scanning Acme's diagram:

- We should treat the base product as a GCP subscription SKU (monthly recurring).
- Metered features (compute credits, per-invocation units) should be mapped to usage-based SKUs that GCP can meter. We'll propose 2 metered SKUs (compute-credits, extra-embeddings).
- For reseller vs direct: Acme wants reseller tagging on some accounts. Vivek, does Redwood support per-buyer reseller flags in our billing exchange with GCP?

I sketched a sample mapping and linked it to the Drive folder (see related_links). I can turn this into a short CSV that GCP ops consumes.

-Karthik

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP purchase path + entitlement mapping for our upcoming listing

Confirming support for per-buyer reseller tagging. Operational notes:

- We require the buyer's billing account ID and billing profile to set the reseller flag during order fulfillment.
- If Acme expects Redwood to route invoices through their reseller partner, we need a signed reseller agreement on file and the reseller's GCP partner ID.
- For invoice transitions (purchase -> invoice), send us the mapping table (buyer email -> billing account ID) and we will push invoice metadata through the entitlement API.

I'll validate any limits on metadata fields with the billing team, but this flow is feasible.

-Vivek

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@acmecloud.com>, AcmeCloud Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, marketplace-ops@google.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Action items & proposed timeline — AcmeCloud GCP listing buyflow

Jason / Acme team —

Thanks — internal alignment complete. Below is the external-facing checklist and timeline we recommend. Please confirm or flag changes by EOD Monday so we can hit your 27 May DocuSign target.

Checklist (what we need from Acme):
- Final SKU matrix CSV (columns: acme_sku_id, description, price_band, billing_type[subscription|metered]) — due Tue 18 May
- Buyer billing account mapping (buyer_email, billing_account_id, reseller_flag) — due Wed 19 May
- Signed reseller agreement (if invoices route through a reseller) — due Thu 20 May (if applicable)
- Procurement-approved order form (we will prepare) — target signature by 27 May

Redwood deliverables (what we will provide):
- SKU <-> GCP entitlement CSV for Marketplace Ops — Wed 19 May
- Procurement checklist + DocuSign order packet (we'll prefill) — Thu 20 May
- Final validation run with GCP Marketplace Ops and acceptance test (we'll schedule) — Fri 21 May

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 18 May: Acme submits CSV and we validate mapping (Karthik).
- Wed 19 May: Redwood returns GCP entitlement CSV and Vivek validates billing metadata exchange.
- Thu 20 May: Redwood shares DocuSign packet for your review; Acme procurement reviews.
- Fri 21 May: Joint validation with GCP Marketplace Ops.
- Mon 24 May: Buffer for redlines.
- Thu 27 May: Target signature & go/no-go for listing prep.

Attachments: acme_sla_redlines_v1.pdf (noted comments on payment terms), purchase_path_diagram_v2.png.

Next steps: Jason — please confirm the timeline and send the SKU CSV by Tue. I've also copied marketplace-ops@google.com so we can coordinate the validation run.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124
